title: Crustacean Cove

body:
Crustacean Cove is a coastal location in Gael associated with a shipwreck and the arrival of refugees. Gartina’s February 2025 account says their ship crashed near the Cove. The people subsequently sheltering around the Tower and the wreck on the coast are related parts of that history, not one established physical site.

A wreck as a possible resource

Dale proposes salvaging timber for a longhouse if the ship is beyond repair. Gartina supports considering the idea but does not know what the tide has done to the remains. A proposal to reuse the vessel is not evidence that it was inspected, declared irreparable or successfully dismantled.

The plan connects coastal wreckage to the refugee community near the Tower. Material might become shelter, but the people affected have yet to be consulted at this point in the conversation. Neither Dale nor Gartina acquires authority over them by proposing help.

A cove with more than one history

The Cove also belongs to Gael’s wider coastal and underwater exploration record. Its setting image does not establish a complete underwater plan or identify every submerged structure. The refugee ship’s route, the detailed crash sequence and the Cove’s history before that arrival remain incompletely recovered.

No completed longhouse, final salvage operation or permanent refugee government is established by this account. The survivors still face a practical question: whether a failed passage can supply material for a community’s future.
